title: A great weather app!
body: I always wonder why for the same location the weather apps give different forecast. This app let know the discrepancies among all the models, it's very interesting and informative. I really like it.

Fantastic!
body: One of the most innovative weather apps I’ve seen. Really fantastic to be able to see score cards for how well the various models have been working. It helps you answer “which model has been tracking the best against the actually weather in my area”. Being able to see historical weather forecasts is also a real bonus. Perfect tool for someone that really wants insight into how weather modeling and forecasts work.
